note: Every food has one English key (foods). aliases maps Spanish names and other spellings to that key, so Spanish cravings, exclusions and recipes still resolve. Lookup ignores case, accents and simple plurals: smartbite_engine/names.py, canonical(name). Spanish names are written without accents.
more_foods_note: Foods the engine knows (name, nutrition) that are not in the AI prompt's food list ("foods"), added 2026-11-21 so names users type count in the macros. Kept out of the prompt list because the food list in the prompts changes only after an eval run (decided 2026-11-03). Most have no typical pack size or price estimate yet.
more_aliases_note: Names added 2026-11-21, for name matching and nutrition only. Kept apart from "aliases" so the dishes picked for the Idea prompt (inspiration.py matches cravings and exclusions through "aliases") stay the same until an eval run.

word_rules.note: For a name no alias matches. The name is read up to the first split word; its singular content words are matched against each rule in order, and the first rule whose words are all there gives the food. A rule does not fire when the name has one of its unless words, when the first or last word is a stop word the rule does not name, or when the name says frozen and the food is not frozen (or the other way round). head: the rule word must be the first (Spanish) or last (English) word. The meal says which food a rule counted a name as. Decided 2026-11-21.
